comparison.objective: Separate six nested cones and distribute them evenly along a curved road, not adjust a mechanical absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Top-edge cone grasping, denesting, transport, and precise upright placement versus fine tool insertion, torque, collar rotation, and response-guided tuning.
comparison.success_condition: All six released, upright, supported, and within spatial/gap tolerances versus consecutive safe carriage stops within dynamic limits.
comparison.reason: This is repeated spatial placement with no adjustment, locking, or dynamic-response loop. The body provides placement tolerances; no spec versions exist.
